# Norman O'Brien

> SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) consultant. Helps businesses get found in search engine results and cited in AI-generated answers. Computer science student (artificial intelligence focus) at Oregon State University.

## Services

- Visibility audit: how a site performs in search results and AI answers, with fixes ranked by impact
- Technical fixes: page speed, indexing, structured data, site structure
- Content built to be cited: pages that answer real customer questions clearly enough to rank and be quoted
- Tracking: monitoring rankings and AI mentions over time

## Background

- B.S. Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence), Oregon State University, minors in Mathematics, Statistics, and Business Information Systems
- Data Analytics Intern, The Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research (June to October 2026)
- Capstone: natural language processing analysis of corporate financial disclosures
- Building an AI visibility tracker: sends the same prompts to ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, plus Google and Bing results; records whether a business is named, its position, and whether its site is cited; reports each metric with a range to separate real change from run-to-run variation
